item.title: Pass References, Not Rows: Data Artifacts for Agent Computations over MCP
item.description: In the previous article we gave an AI agent a safe place to run Python. That answered where agent-written code executes. This follow-up answers a question that turns out to matter just as much: what data does the model actually need to see? Usually the answer is much less than we give it.
